name: Rain
source: Rain is a demon famous for her great strength, skillful magic and dodgy mind. But she was sealed once by Silver inside Elena's body. Though, when Elena drops her guard, Rain comes out and tries her best to extract the Sacred Orb from Mamoru and use it for her own purposes. Despite how much trouble Rain caused to the princesses and all the Arcadare people in the past, she deserves some compassion. After all, her whole long life was spent in solitude, without close friends and beloved man.
